title: WPSS/1749/2022 of MOHAN SINGH BISHT Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

Hon 'b le Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J.
Mr. V.C. Gupta, Senior Advocate,
assisted by Mr. A.M. Saklani, Advocate for
the petitioner.
Mr. P.S. Bisht, Additional CSC, for
the State/ respondent no. 1.
Mr. Rakesh Thapliyal, Senior
Advocate, for the respondents no. 2 to 4.
According to the petitioner, he was
appointed as Beldar, on daily wages, in
Garhwal Jal Sansthan w.e.f. 1.10.1987;
subsequently, he was appointed in work-charged establishm ent in Garhwal Jal
Sansthan w.e.f. 1.1.1996; ultim ately, his
services were regularised on 1.11.2003 in
Uttarakhand Jal Sansthan. Petitioner has
now retired from service on 31.12.2022.
By m eans of this writ petition,
petitioner has sought the following reliefs:
"i) I ssue a writ, order or direction in
the nature of certiorari for quashing the
im pugned order dated 02.08.2022, passed
by Respondent no. 2 (Annexure No. 5 to
this writ petition).
ii) I ssue a writ, order or direction in
the nature of mandam us com manding the
respondents to prom ote the petitioner on
the Class I I I post.
iii) I ssue a writ, order or direction in
the nature of mandam us com manding the
respondents to count the service of the
petitioner rendered in the work charge

establishm ent for the purpose of pensionary
benefit.
iv) I ssue a writ, order or direction in
the nature of mandam us com manding the
respondents to give Grade Pay of Rs. 2400
in Pay Scale of Rs. 5200-20200 to the
petitioner on the basis of recom m endation
of Screening Com m ittee dated 16.10.2008
from 01.11.2013.
v) I ssue a writ, order or direction in
the nature of mandam us com manding the
respondents to give the Avartak shulk to the
petitioner as has been given to other
em ployees of departm ent.
vi) I ssue a writ, order or direction in
the nature of mandam us com manding the
respondents to give the Sanhat Vetan to the
petitioner as has been given to other
em ployees of department from
01.11.2013."
Learned Senior Counsel appearing
for the petitioner submits that he is only
pressing prayer no. 1, 3 and 4 and is giving
up other reliefs, as prayed in the writ
petition.
As regards claim of petitioner for
Grade Pay of ₹2400 on the basis of MACP,
petitioner's representation has been
rejected vide order dated 2.8.2022. The
reason assigned for rejecting petitioner's
claim is that he has not com pleted 30 years
of service, which is the qualifying service for
grant of said grade pay.
Since no m aterial has been brought
on record to substantiate the plea raised by
petitioner that he is entitled to such grade
pay before com pletion of 30 years,
therefore, there is no scope for interference

with the aforem entioned rejection order.
So far as benefit of services
rendered by petitioner in work-charged
establishm ent for grant of pensionary
benefit is concerned, learned Senior Counsel
appearing for the petitioner submits that
since petitioner has served in work-charged
establishm ent for m ore than eight years,
therefore, such period of service deserves to
be treated as qualifying service for the
purpose of pensionary benefit. I n other
words, service rendered by petitioner in
work-charged establishment has to be
added to service rendered by petitioner,
post regularisation. I n support of this
contention, he has placed reliance upon a
judgment rendered by Hon'ble Suprem e
Court in Prem Singh v. State of U.P. &
Others, reported in (2019) 10 SCC 516.
Learned Senior Counsel appearing
for Uttarakhand Jal Sansthan fairly submits
that the controversy raised in the writ
petition has been laid to rest by the Hon'ble
Suprem e Court in the aforesaid judgment,
as regards pension to retired em ployees
who rendered services in work-charged
establishm ent. He further submits that date
of petitioner's appointment in work-charged
establishm ent is not admitted.
Learned Senior Counsel appearing
for the petitioner has drawn attention of this
Court to the pleadings m ade in para 7 of the
writ petition, where it has been stated that
petitioner was conferred work-charged
status w.e.f. 1.1.1996, which averment has
not been denied in counter affidavit filed on
behalf of Uttarakhand Jal Sansthan.
I n above view of the m atter, writ
petition is partly allowed. Respondents are
directed to take into account the services

rendered by petitioner in work-charged
establishm ent for purpose of computation of
qualifying service for grant of pension and,
accordingly, com pute the am ount payable
as pension to him . Such exercise shall be
com pleted within six weeks from the date of
production of certified copy of this order.
 ( Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J.)
